name: Phone Photos
author: ryuhzk
description: Browse, search, download and delete the photos and videos on an Android phone plugged in over USB.

barWidget.description: Appears while an Android phone is connected over USB and opens a gallery of its photos and videos.

schema.label: Move deleted items to this computer's Trash
schema.description: Before deleting from the phone, copy each item into ~/Pictures/<phone name>/ and move that copy to the Trash, so it can be restored. The delete dialog remembers the last choice.
